scope: No claim of verified size assignment/cap/personalized source photos; sourcing clarification is SKU specific

sports.2506: For sports bottle model 2506, the original catalog entry contains a capacity discrepancy: it states 60 ml while giving body dimensions of approximately 8.3 by 26.8 cm. These figures should not be turned into a confirmed volume or an overseas ounce size class. This product's useful purchasing starting point is a source check, not a speculative feature claim. Ask XUYI for the original factory model sheet, an assembled bottle with the actual measuring scale and a written confirmation of its filled capacity. The catalog records PC, PP and ABS component families, blue, green, black and brown color references, an OPP bag and 60 pieces per 60 by 43 by 55 cm carton; every item still requires exact-order verification. Approve the real lid and branding area before printing packaging.

shakers.5247: Shaker model 5247 appears in a combined factory catalog reference that describes 450 ml and 700 ml options in PP, with a 450 ml example measuring about 6.5 by 16.8 cm. The same source image is also associated with model 5248, so these facts do not establish which capacity, lid or mixing insert belongs specifically to 5247. For buyers requesting a quote under this code, ask for a clearly labeled 5247 sample, a photograph of the actual opening and any included mixing components, and a written model-to-capacity mapping. Review where a logo and any measurement scale would appear on the assembled product. Do not advertise accessories, dishwasher suitability, leakproof performance or packing quantities without model-specific evidence. Keep the final approved sample and quotation identified as 5247.
shakers.5248: The factory catalog lists shaker model 5248 beside 5247 using a shared photograph and a combined reference to 450 ml and 700 ml PP shaker options. It does not supply dependable evidence of a different closure, strainer, shell shape or volume assignment for 5248 alone. An importer comparing these codes should request two separately labeled assembled samples and ask the factory to identify any actual difference on a written comparison sheet. Compare the drinking opening, removable parts, physical capacity marking and branding surface side by side rather than assuming that the numbers imply different tooling. The recorded 450 ml example dimension applies to that size reference, not automatically to 5248. Obtain exact-model photos, approved color and packing information, and destination-market material evidence before placing or repeating an order.
